correctness.rationale: For a unit-weight prime-dimensional graph state, additive-character orthogonality shows all nonzero cut eigenvalues are p^{-r}, with multiplicity p^r where r=rank_Fp D. Direct adjacency accounting for the specified alternating outer/inner cut gives cyclic blocks [[I+P,I],[I,Q]], with Q=0 at even k and Q=P^a+P^{-(a+1)} for k=2a+1. The even case is invertible; the Schur complement is a cyclic polynomial f_{p,k}(P), whose nullity equals deg gcd(f,X^m-1) even for inseparable factors. f(1)=3 causes universal qutrit loss at odd k; explicit k=5 polynomial factorizations give both valuation staircases. Independent edge-built modular matrices matched the gcd prediction in 220 checks for p=2,3,5,7, 2<=m<=11 and all 1<=k<m.
residual_risks: Finite checks are corroboration, not a substitute for the universal mathematical proof.
